pages.text: $(bold)Jinkela$()$(br)Applied to farmland, it unleashes the effect of bone meal $(bold)5$() times across a $(bold)3x3$() area.$(br2)$(bold)Organic Fertilizer$()$(br)Works $(bold)exactly like$() bone meal - the honest growth booster.

$(bold)Watering Can$()$(br)Right-click a water source to fill it, then $(bold)hold right-click$() on farmland to water it; crops have a chance to ripen.$(br2)$(bold)Fertile Farmland$()$(br)On random ticks it advances the crop above it by one growth stage.
